ModMetaData.name: Ability Genes
ModMetaData.author: vilasone455
ModMetaData.description:
Biotech gives you only a handful of genes that grant an active ability. This mod expands that list.
Every gene in this mod appears under the "Ability" category in the gene assembler and grants its carrier a usable ability gizmo, balanced with a metabolism / complexity cost and a cooldown.
Requires Biotech. No other mods, frameworks, or DLC are required.
